what: Superseded 2026-11-15.v1 stub (PR #376) hardcoded synthetic alphamissense_score, evo2_zero_shot_score, and alphagenome_avi_score floats across 20 CFTR variants without API provenance, including alphamissense_score=0.94 on F508del and 0.89 on I507del.
why: AlphaMissense (Cheng et al. 2023, DOI 10.1126/science.adg7492) scores single-amino-acid substitutions only and cannot score 3-bp in-frame deletions, splice variants, or premature stop codons; replaced all synthetic values with recorded MyVariant dbnsfp.alphamissense/revel/cadd records and None ('not stated') where unmeasured, enforced by negative control non_missense_alphamissense_rejected.

what: Superseded 2026-11-15.v1 stub labeled N1303K as modulator_responsive=0.
why: Direct check against US FDA openFDA Structured Product Labels showed N1303K is listed as responsive in both TRIKAFTA v23 Table 6 (effective 2026-06-22) and ALYFTREK v9 Table 5 (effective 2026-08-26) via human bronchial epithelial (HBE) data while absent from KALYDECO v36 Table 3 and SYMDEKO v22 Table 6; corrected all 30 variant labels from live openFDA SPL tables.

what: Superseded 2026-11-15.v1 stub assigned S549N to variant_family='gating_missense_heldout' and split NBD1 variants across train and test.
why: Appending '_heldout' disguised a missense gating variant as a distinct family while sharing NBD1 structural context across splits; replaced with a strict 4-family allowlist (missense, inframe_indel, splice_regulatory, class_i_ptc_frameshift), P13569 6-domain separation (0 domain overlap, minimum cross-split codon gap 71 > 5), and 4-fold Leave-One-Family-Out evaluation.

what: Attempted to ingest MaveDB CC0 dump (mavedb-dump-zenodo) and McKee 2023 / Tedman 2025 deep mutational scanning tables (cftr-dms-mckee-2023, cftr-dms-tedman-2025) for empirical trafficking/theratype curves.
why: All three catalog entries remain access: manual and claim_label: unverified in sources/catalog.yaml awaiting human maintainer terms verification per HUMAN-TASKS.md (T-0928); load_mavedb_cc0_csv fails closed with PermissionError until ratified.

what: PRED-0010 hypothesis that pre-registered AlphaMissense responsiveness score s_AM(x) = 1 - AM(x) achieves test_coverage >= 0.80, conditional_auroc >= 0.75, and abstention_aware_auroc >= 0.75 on the held-out 20-variant TRIKAFTA v23 test split and matches or beats a deterministic sequence-consequence class baseline.
why: Refuted on fixed split 2026-11-21.v2: AlphaMissense scored only 11/20 held-out variants (coverage 0.5500 < 0.80, abstaining on F508del, I507del, 3 splice variants, and 4 Class I nonsense variants) and achieved conditional missense ROC-AUC 0.5333 (8/15) and abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.5101 (101/198) vs 0.6818 (15/22) for the sequence-consequence baseline because modulator-responsive (G551D=0.9897, N1303K=0.9907, S549N=0.9503) and modulator-refractory (L467P=0.9858, Y569D=0.9964, R560T=0.9846) CF-causing missense alleles both carry high evolutionary pathogenicity scores.

what: Round-1 blind diff review (ac9c06ad-5014-40b2-a7a6-926239ee2363 and ornith-1.5:35b) found _read_catalog_source_status / load_mavedb_cc0_csv used a denylist without stripping inline YAML comments or enforcing 4-space key indentation, and independent_audit.py parsed JSON via float before Decimal conversion and omitted single-class None handling.
why: Hardened _read_catalog_source_status to enforce 2-space '- id:' and 4-space 'access:' / 'claim_label:' indentation with '#' comment stripping and strict allowlist access in {'fetch', 'api'} and claim_label == 'verified', switched independent_audit.py to json.loads(..., parse_float=Decimal) with ROUND_HALF_EVEN + exact fraction assertions in --check + unrounded 1e-9 parity tests, added fs/* and [0,1] finite score provenance guards, and removed stale family aliases from cftr_variant_to_delivery_deducer.py.
